info.name: Palo Alto Networks Prisma Cloud Code Security API
info.description:
REST API for Prisma Cloud Code Security (Application Security) providing programmatic access to repository management, CI/CD integration scanning, scan execution and status, suppression rules for policy violations, code errors by branch, and fix suggestions for pull requests. The API enables integration with version control systems such as GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure Repos, and supports scanning Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes manifests, Dockerfiles, and other IaC frameworks using the Checkov scanning engine. Authentication requires a JWT token obtained from the Prisma Cloud CSPM /login endpoint, passed via the x-redlock-auth header.

Contact Support:
